content: Hi how can i assist you today
My smart fridge suggests the exact recipe I’m thinking about. It pops up as if it heard me.
Recipe cards often key off recent grocery receipts, expiring items, and past selections. Were those ingredients recently scanned or added?
I’d logged tomatoes and pasta yesterday.
Those would steer toward a pasta suggestion. Does it also suggest unrelated recipes when the inventory changes?
When I add chicken, it switches to stir-fry ideas.
That shift tracks inventory logic. If a suggestion appears without matching items, the activity history usually shows what cue was used.
I’ll check the activity log next time.
The log typically lists scans, expirations, and recommendation reasons.
